newsitem.title: UK: Pizza Express in 25 mln stg restaurant buy.
newsitem.headline: Pizza Express in 25 mln stg restaurant buy.

text.p: Pizza Express Plc said it is to buy up to 33 restaurants for 25 million stg and raise 25.5 million stg net via share issues in the U.S. and UK.
The restaurants comprise 32 PizzaExpress franchised restaurants and Mulino, an independent pizza restaurant trading in Mill Hill in London.
Pizza Express expects the acquisition to enhance earnings immediately.
It will pay 17.9 million stg in cash, 200,000 stg by issuing 42,105 new ordinary shares at 475 pence each, six million stg in loan notes and 900,000 by the repayment of liabilities.
The placing and open offer is for 3,055,727 new ordinary shares at 475 pence each in the UK and 2,631,578 new ordinary shares in the U.S.
The UK placing and open offer has been fully underwritten by Credit Lyonnais Laing. The U.S. placing has not been underwritten.
The company said the net assets of the franchised restaurants will be approximately 1.85 million stg at completion of the deal, subject to adjustment.

Pizza Express said the deal will increase control over its restaurants, enabling it to protect the market position and reputation of its existing company-owned restaurants. -- London Newsroom +44 171 542 7717
